title: Story Development & Scripting
description:
At Boxonia, we spark creativity, develop and bring enthralling story ideas embellished in African culture and themes. Our team crafts riveting narratives and writes stories (scripts) that showcase the richness in diverse African cultures.

Our story bank is a treasure cache of unique and rare ideas, carefully, stored for future productions.

children.title: Pre-Production
children.description: Once scripting and story development are complete, production planning commences. This stage includes budgeting, hiring crew and cast, setting schedules, and shaping the marketing approach. Every detail is considered to build a strong and efficient foundation for the project

children.title: Principal Photography
children.description: With pre-production wrapped, we move into principal photography as scheduled. Boxonia manages all areas of the shoot, from scheduling and budget supervision to crew coordination and on-set logistics. We ensure a seamless production process while maintaining a high standard of quality

children.title: Post Production
children.description: Post-production is considered from the very beginning. Involving the post team early allows for a more cohesive and intentional creative process.

title: Marketing & distribution
description:
Marketing is more than a skill. It is our superpower. We draw from traditional methods, innovative digital campaigns and bold experimental strategies to give every project the reach it deserves.
We work to connect each production with the right audience and platform, creating distribution strategies that ensure our projects are seen, appreciated and remembered.

title: IP Protection: Safeguarding Creativity at Boxonia
description: Our commitment extends beyond production. We prioritize the legal security of every project, protecting intellectual property, ensuring that contracts, rights, and licenses are properly structured and managed. At Boxonia, safeguarding your vision is as important as bringing it to life.
